title: Block at a given index
statement: Given natural numbers $a$ and $k$, a Boolean list $z$, and an index $i$, decode $z$ as a pair of lists and take from the second list the block of length $a(m+1)^k$ beginning at position $i\,a(m+1)^k$, where $m$ is the length of the first decoded list.
caveat: The pair-decoding convention is not included.
